title: Chart-HQA: A Benchmark for Hypothetical Question Answering in Charts

bias_targets.methodology: The paper measures this bias by introducing a Chart Hypothetical Question Answering (HQA) task. It applies counterfactual assumptions to standard chart questions to evaluate whether Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) genuinely reason through the visual chart content and hypothetical constraints, or if they biasedly default to retrieving real-world facts from their pre-trained parametric memory.
